Name: Truffle Oil Refiner
Author: nevaliavonaegir
Description:
[b]Info:
[/b]Adds a new recipe for a machine that can refine truffle oil up to iridium quality.

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642/]Custom Casks Mod[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720/]Json Assets[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536/]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[/list]
[b]How it works:[/b]
[list]
[*]Marnie sends you a letter in the mail once you unlock the oil maker machine (farming level 8).
[*]You can craft it with [b]30 wood[/b] and [b]1 gold bar[/b].
[*]The truffle oil refiner acts similarly to casks, except they can be placed anywhere and only takes truffle oil.
[*]It takes [b]5 days[/b] for the truffle oil to reach iridium quality, which [b]doubles[/b] the sell price.
[/list]
[b]Translations:[/b]
There are currently no translations to languages other than English, but feel free to reach out to me if you have a translation for your language.

[b]My other mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12574]Easier Crystalarium Recipe[/url]﻿
[/list]
